newsitem.title: USA: NYPA 780 MW nuke out Sat for planned maintenance.
newsitem.headline: NYPA 780 MW nuke out Sat for planned maintenance.

text.p: New York Power Authority's (NYPA) 780 megawatt James A. Fitzpatrick nuclear power plant was scheduled to be shut down Saturday for about 45 days for refueling and maintenance, the company said.
During the outage a total of 192 of 560 fuel assemblies in the reactor core will be replaced and modifications to the plant will boost production by 33,000 kilowatts, NYPA said in a statement.
Following the outage, the plant will be capable of operating for 24 months before refueling is again necessary, the company said.
The Scriba, N.Y. unit's last refueling was in March, 1997.
About 900 additional workers will join the plant's regular staff for the outage, NYPA said.
-- Chris Reese, New York Power Desk 212-859-1627
